title: Predicted vs observed share of ocean that would change color

source.name: Global climate-change trends detected in indicators of ocean ecology
source.publisher: Nature / MIT (B.B. Cael et al.); model by Stephanie Dutkiewicz (2019)

notes: A 2019 greenhouse-gas climate model predicted roughly 50% of the ocean's surface would shift color; 2023 satellite analysis of real MODIS data found 56%.
